I am using RStudio Version 0.99.876 and the application works fine in RStudio.

parts:
My guess is that there were two deployments going on at once.  The fist one finished, and this was the error on the second one.
Glad everything is working.
On Mon, Feb 8, 2016 at 7:56 AM, Mark Huber <huber...@gmail.com> wrote:

Uploading bundle for application: 82421...DONE
Deploying bundle: 368548 for application: 82421 ...
Error: HTTP 409
POST https://api.shinyapps.io/v1/applications/82421/deploy
Unable to dispatch task for application-82421: 1 tasks in progress
Execution halted

and i get a 404: Not Found when i go to https://api.shinyapps.io/

but it looks like even with the error messages, the app got published and it appears to be working correctly.

Thank you very much for the help. i would have never figured that out!

On Monday, February 8, 2016 at 10:33:19 AM UTC-5, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
What are you seeing?

On Mon, Feb 8, 2016 at 7:29 AM, Mark Huber <huber...@gmail.com> wrote:
i am trying the %20 in the string but now i can't publish.  problems with the shinyapps.io server...  i'll try again later

On Monday, February 8, 2016 at 10:00:20 AM UTC-5, Andy Kipp wrote:
You must escape the spaces. You can not have a space in the URL. 

See URLEncode:

https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/utils/html/URLencode.html

On Mon, Feb 8, 2016 at 9:25 AM, Mark Huber <huber...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks for the quick response Tareef,

But the spaces are part of the expected format for the NOAA API.  the UIRL will not work without the spaces. they give examples here: http://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/
the app works find in RStudio. 

I must be something else.

On Monday, February 8, 2016 at 9:17:32 AM UTC-5, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
Mark,
I think your date format for end_date is incorrect, it has spaces and URLs can't have spaces to my knowledge.

-Tareef
